item.ptxt: Blind spot monitor system has a blind spot monitor function and rear cross traffic alert function. This system tells the driver of presence of a vehicle diagonally in the rear not reflected in the door mirror.
At the time of lane change, for example, unexpected approaching vehicle is told to the driver through the indicator light in the door mirror and warning buzzer.
For detecting a vehicle diagonally in the rear, the system uses a millimeter wave (radio wave) radar device incorporated in blind spot monitor control module.

Blind spot monitor system consists of blind spot monitor control module (main), blind spot monitor control module (sub), blind spot monitor indicator light (right and left), combination meter, ECM, TCM (A/T model), BCM, ESP® control module and lighting and turn signal switch.

topic.title: Blind spot monitor function
topic.ptxt: When the blind spot monitor function detects a vehicle approaching laterally and from the rear on the neighboring lane, the system alerts the driver lighting blind spot monitor indicator light in the door mirror. Further, if turn signal switch is operated at that moment, blind spot monitor indicator light blinks and warning buzzer sounds to urge suspension of the lane change.

topic.title: Rear cross traffic alert function
topic.ptxt: When moving backward, if rear cross traffic alert function detects vehicle(s) approaching laterally from the rear, the system indicates alarm sign in the information display and sounds warning buzzer to assist the driver’s safe operation.
